tagline_en: High torque, safe control, maximum efficiency.
tagline_tr: Yüksek tork, güvenli kontrol, maksimum verim.
description_en: The BullDrill Top-Head Drive series features robust construction designed for challenging field conditions, with user-friendly systems and mobile track capability. Compatible with B-N-H-P drill rod sets for fast field adaptation.

features_detail.title: Conquer Any Terrain with Confidence
features_detail.body: The robust steel track design enables effortless mobility even in the harshest ground conditions. Combined with a remote-control option, you can ensure maximum safety and ease of operation for tramming.

features_detail.title: Seamless Adaptability with Top-Head Rotary Unit
features_detail.body: The top-head system is compatible with the B-N-H-P drill rod set. It enables fast adaptation in the field and minimizes downtime.

features_detail.title: PLC Monitoring for Enhanced Efficiency
features_detail.body: Equipped with a reliable control and warning system, our cutting-edge control panel features indicators to monitor all drilling equipment and functions. The 10-inch touchscreen PLC display provides real-time updates on engine performance and alerts for potential issues.

features_detail.title: Unstoppable Power
features_detail.body: Driven by a powerful diesel engine, our rig delivers consistent and reliable performance for even the most demanding operations.

features_detail.title: Optimized Cooling for Peak Performance
features_detail.body: A high-capacity cooling system ensures smooth operation, even during intensive drilling sessions.

features_detail.title: Effortless Self-Loading Capability
features_detail.body: Lifts itself up to 1.4 meters, allowing for fast and easy loading without the need for a platform. Hydraulic jack stabilizers ensure easy setup and stability on sloping and challenging terrains.

features_detail.title: Semi-Automatic Rod Handling System
features_detail.body: A hydraulic arm enables semi-automatic rod handling, reducing operation time while increasing safety and efficiency.

features_detail.title: User-Friendly Control Panel
features_detail.body: Enjoy simplicity and convenience with our easy-to-use control interface, designed to keep you focused on the task.

features_detail.title: Advanced Safety Features
features_detail.body: Our rigs are equipped with a safety cage and emergency stop buttons, ensuring safer drilling operations for your crew. The automatic locking system of the main winch offers a safe and reliable lifting solution.

name_tr: BullDrill Kızak Tipi Yer Altı Sondaj Makineleri
tagline_en: Compact power, full control, maximum torque.
tagline_tr: Kompakt güç, tam kontrol, maksimum tork.
description_en: Compact underground drilling systems featuring ABB/SIEMENS electric motors, KAWASAKI tandem hydraulic pumps, telescopic mast with 360° drilling capability, and automatic wireline winding for confined space operations.
features: Open feed spindle rotary head (up to 1200 rpm, 1020–2060 Nm torque)
High-strength TC insert jaw rod holder (70–130 kN axial force)
Safety cage with dual emergency stop system

features_detail.title: High-End Electric Motor
features_detail.body: Powered by ABB or SIEMENS electric motors, ensuring high performance and reliability. With power outputs ranging from 55 to 110 kW and speeds up to 1480 rpm, they deliver efficient and consistent drilling capability.

features_detail.title: Robust Hydraulic Pumps
features_detail.body: Features four KAWASAKI pumps in tandem at 280–315 bar pressure, cooled by HYDAC water-cooling and PARKER/AKG air-cooling systems.

features_detail.title: Vigorous Rotary Head
features_detail.body: Open-feed spindle reaching 1200 rpm with torque of 1020–2060 Nm, powered by PARKER or REXROTH hydromotors for efficient operation.

features_detail.title: Easy Navigation With Double Reducers
features_detail.body: Two hydraulically-controlled reducers positioned at the bottom and at the boom-to-mast connection enable effortless and fast 360° drilling.

features_detail.title: Wireline System With Automatic Winding Feature
features_detail.body: Reduces manual handling risks with consistent tension control, prevents cable snapping, minimizes wear and tear, and improves core retrieval speed and accuracy.

features_detail.title: High-Strength Rod Holder
features_detail.body: Gas-pressure-operated system with TC insert jaws providing 70–130 kN axial holding force for firm and reliable rod security.

features_detail.title: User-Friendly Control Panel
features_detail.body: Intuitive and easy-to-use control panel allows precise control over drilling operations while maintaining advanced functionality.

features_detail.title: Safety Cage For Sound Operations
features_detail.body: Mechanically or hydraulically controlled safety cage enhances operator protection during drilling.

features_detail.title: Dual Emergency Stop System
features_detail.body: Control panel emergency button plus additional wire emergency stop on the mast for immediate shutdown capability in critical situations.

name_tr: BullDrill Paletli Yer Altı Sondaj Makineleri
tagline_en: Strong ground grip, full control, high torque.
tagline_tr: Güçlü tutuş, tam kontrol, yüksek tork.
description_en: Designed for challenging underground conditions with USTEC crawler track systems, PERKINS diesel tramming engine, high-torque spindle heads, and robust construction for maximum maneuverability.
features: Open feed spindle rotary head (up to 1200 rpm, 1020–2060 Nm torque)
USTEC crawler system for underground mobility (up to 3.38 km/h)
PERKINS 4-cylinder diesel tramming engine (37 kW / 50 hp)
Safety cage with dual emergency stop system

features_detail.title: High-End Electric Motor
features_detail.body: Powered by ABB or SIEMENS electric motors, ensuring high performance and reliability. With power outputs ranging from 55 to 110 kW and speeds up to 1480 rpm, they deliver efficient and consistent drilling capability.

features_detail.title: Robust Hydraulic Pumps
features_detail.body: Feature four KAWASAKI hydraulic pumps in a tandem configuration, operating at 280 or 315 bar pressure. The system is cooled by a HYDAC water-cooling unit and an air-cooling system from PARKER or AKG.

features_detail.title: Vigorous Rotary Head
features_detail.body: Open-feed spindle rotary head reaches speeds up to 1200 rpm with torque ranging from 1020 to 2060 Nm. It is powered by PARKER or REXROTH hydromotors for smooth and powerful operation.

features_detail.title: Easy Navigation With Double Reducers
features_detail.body: Two hydraulically-controlled reducers are positioned at the bottom and at the boom-to-mast connection. This setup allows for effortless and fast 360° drilling in underground operations.

features_detail.title: Wireline System With Automatic Winding Feature
features_detail.body: The automatic winding wireline system reduces manual handling risks and ensures consistent tension control. It prevents cable snapping, minimizes wear and tear, and improves core retrieval speed and accuracy.

features_detail.title: High-Strength Rod Holder
features_detail.body: Gas-pressure-operated rod holder secures rods using TC insert jaws, providing an axial holding force of 70 to 130 kN, ensuring firm and reliable grip.

features_detail.title: User-Friendly Control Panel
features_detail.body: An intuitive and easy-to-use control panel allows precise control over drilling operations while maintaining advanced functionality.

features_detail.title: Highly Efficient Diesel Engine for Tramming
features_detail.body: A PERKINS 4-cylinder diesel engine generating 50 hp powers the tramming system, ensuring reliable movement and positioning in underground environments.

features_detail.title: High-Quality Crawler System
features_detail.body: Manufactured by USTEC, the crawler system delivers excellent traction and stability, reaching speeds of up to 3.4 km/h for smooth maneuverability.

features_detail.title: Integrated Flush Pump
features_detail.body: The triplex mud pump, attached onto the rig chassis, provides a flow rate of 90–140 l/min at 60–70 bar pressure, ensuring efficient flushing performance.

features_detail.title: Safety Cage for Sound Operations
features_detail.body: A mechanically or hydraulically controlled safety cage enhances operator safety during drilling operations.

features_detail.title: Dual Emergency Stop System
features_detail.body: An emergency stop button is located on the control panel, with an additional wire emergency stop positioned on the mast for immediate shutdown in critical situations.

name_tr: BullDrill Ex-Proof Yer Altı Sondaj Makineleri
tagline_en: Harsh environments, full protection, high performance.
tagline_tr: Zorlu ortamlar, tam koruma, yüksek performans.
description_en: Türkiye's first and only ATEX-certified explosion-proof drilling rigs. Designed for environments with methane emissions. Features CEMP/ABB Ex-proof motors, fire-resistant hydraulic fluid (HFD-U 68), D-type explosion-proof electrical enclosure, methane detector, and 120°C thermocouple overheat protection.
features: 100% ATEX-certified explosion-proof drilling rigs — first of their kind in Türkiye
ATEX-certified ABB or CEMP electric motors (660V or 1100V)
KAWASAKI four-unit tandem ATEX-certified hydraulic pumps
Open feed spindle rotary head (up to 1200 rpm)
USTEC crawler system with PERKINS tramming engine

features_detail.title: 100% Explosion-Proof Drilling Rigs
features_detail.body: BARKOM is Türkiye's first and only manufacturer of ATEX-certified explosion-proof drilling rigs, designed for safe operation in hazardous environments where methane gas emissions create explosive risks.

features_detail.title: High-End Electric Motor
features_detail.body: Ex-proof ABB or CEMP motors deliver power outputs ranging from 55 to 110 kW and speeds up to 1480 rpm for consistent drilling capability.

features_detail.title: Robust Hydraulic Pumps
features_detail.body: Four ex-proof KAWASAKI hydraulic pumps in a tandem configuration, operating at 280 or 315 bar pressure with cooling via HYDAC and PARKER/AKG systems.

features_detail.title: Vigorous Rotary Head
features_detail.body: Open-feed spindle reaches speeds up to 1200 rpm with torque ranging from 1020 to 2060 Nm using PARKER or REXROTH ex-proof hydromotors.

features_detail.title: Easy Navigation With Double Reducers
features_detail.body: Two hydraulically-controlled reducers are positioned at the bottom and at the boom-to-mast connection enabling 360° drilling capability.

features_detail.title: Wireline System With Automatic Winding Feature
features_detail.body: The automatic winding wireline system reduces manual handling risks and ensures consistent tension control. It prevents cable snapping and minimizes wear and tear.

features_detail.title: High-Strength Rod Holder
features_detail.body: Gas-pressure-operated rod holder secures rods using TC insert jaws, providing an axial holding force of 70 to 130 kN.

features_detail.title: User-Friendly Control Panel
features_detail.body: Intuitive and easy-to-use control panel allows precise control over drilling operations while maintaining advanced functionality.

features_detail.title: High-Quality Crawler System
features_detail.body: Manufactured by USTEC, the ex-proof crawler system delivers excellent traction and stability, reaching speeds of up to 3.4 km/h.

features_detail.title: Integrated Flush Pump
features_detail.body: Triplex mud pump, attached onto the rig chassis, provides a flow rate of 90–140 l/min at 60–70 bar pressure, ensuring efficient flushing performance.

features_detail.title: Safety Cage For Sound Operations
features_detail.body: Mechanically or hydraulically controlled safety cage enhances operator safety during drilling operations.

features_detail.title: Dual Emergency Stop System
features_detail.body: An emergency stop button is located on the control panel, with an additional wire emergency stop positioned on the mast for immediate shutdown.

features_detail.title: D-type Explosion-Proof Electrical Box
features_detail.body: D-Type electrical enclosure prevents internal sparks or arcs from igniting external gases or dust. Its flameproof construction ensures containment.

features_detail.title: Explosion-Proof Power Input System
features_detail.body: Ex-proof power input box is designed to eliminate ignition risks, containing internal sparks or explosions and preventing their propagation.

features_detail.title: Integrated Thermocouple For Automatic Overheat Protection
features_detail.body: Thermocouple continuously monitors hydraulic oil temperature. If it reaches 120°C, the system automatically shuts down, preventing overheating.

features_detail.title: Methane Gas Detector
features_detail.body: Methane detector continuously monitors CH₄ levels, preventing dangerous gas buildup and ensuring safe drilling in coal mines.

features_detail.title: Fire-Resistant Hydraulic Tank
features_detail.body: 130-liter hydraulic tank is filled with HFD-U 68 fire-resistant synthetic hydraulic fluid, meeting strict ex-proof safety regulations.
